title: Best Silk Pajamas 2026: 5 sets through 90 wash cycles
description: Lunya, Olivia von Halle, LilySilk, Papinelle, Fishers Finery — 90 nights of wear, 30 home-wash cycles. Pilling rate, drape loss, 22 vs 19 momme silk compared.
lede: Five silk pajama sets. 90 nights of wear. Home-laundered each on delicate 30 times. Measured drape loss, pilling, color fade.
methodology: Cotton bedding, 68°F bedroom, mesh laundry bag, Woolite Delicates, no dryer. Standardized fabric weight test at day 0, 30, 60, 90. Pilling counted under magnifier.

sections.heading: 22-momme vs 19-momme survival
paragraphs: 22-momme stretch silk (Lunya): zero pilling at 30 washes, drape held 95%. LilySilk 22-momme: 2 pills, drape 93%. 19-momme sets (Olivia von Halle, Papinelle, Fishers Finery) started pilling at wash 15-20.
Lunya's 8% spandex makes the set work for active sleepers; Olivia von Halle 100% silk twill drapes like liquid but requires dry-cleaning. Best cost-per-wear: LilySilk at $129.

faqs.a: Momme = silk weight per area. 19 = standard, 22 = premium (30-40% more expensive but thicker, more durable). 25+ is too warm for most sleepers.
Lunya and LilySilk explicitly support delicate-cycle machine wash in mesh bag. Olivia von Halle and Fishers Finery say dry-clean — we confirmed by destroying our test Olivia von Halle pair.

lunya-washable-silk-set.review: Best overall. Stretch silk's 8% spandex moves with you. 22-momme survives 30+ washes with negligible pilling.

olivia-von-halle-coco-pj.review: Most beautiful in test — 19-momme silk twill drapes like liquid. Dry-clean only and $695 price restrict to special occasions.

lilysilk-classic-silk-pj.review: Factory-direct, half the Western brand price. 22-momme mulberry handles 30 washes well. OEKO-TEX certified.

papinelle-washable-silk-pj.review: 19-momme silk-charmeuse, machine washable. Lighter than Lunya, works for tropical climates.

fishers-finery-100-mulberry.review: Cheapest real silk at $99. 19-momme, OEKO-TEX, slim fit. Pilling at wash 15 — a 1-2 year set.

pinDescription: 5 silk pajama sets through 90 wash cycles. Lunya vs Olivia von Halle vs LilySilk vs Papinelle vs Fishers Finery. 22 vs 19 momme explained. #silkpajamas
